title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_' (HCF 2026)
synopsis:
Broadway Cinemas exclusively presents HYBE CINE FEST 2026 ! bringing your favorite HYBE’s artists to the big screen! Featureing SEVENTEEN, ENHYPEN, TXT and BTS!  EVERYWHERE, WE CHEER!


Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential.  Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
百老匯戲院獨家呈獻 HYBE CINE FEST 2026！將你最愛的 HYBE 旗下藝人帶到大銀幕！ 陣容包括 SEVENTEEN、ENHYPEN、TXT 同埋 BTS！EVERYWHERE, WE CHEER! 應援無處不在！

 

慶祝出道 10 週年，SEVENTEEN 懷抱重新出發的決心，以《NEW_》之名，正式啟動世界巡迴演唱會。憑藉無可匹敵的舞台魅力與爆發力，SEVENTEEN 再次證明了他們的無限潛能。在大銀幕上親身感受演唱會的狂熱，見證每一位成員個人魅力的爆發時刻！
